DISCUSS: Postgame Analysis: Florida Gators 52, Ole Miss Rebels 28
Florida dominated No. 4 Ole Miss for a season-defining win, but Jon Sumrall says the Gators are still a work in progress. Loren Meadows on what he expected, what he got and what comes next.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/postgame-analysis-florida-gators-52-ole-miss-rebel-28
By Loren Meadows. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
